{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure a clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: convert to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with invalid revenue (6 rows)
initial_count = len(sales_df)
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])
final_count = len(sales_df)

# Confirm no more invalid revenue
assert sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum() == 0, 'There are still null values in revenue after cleaning.'

# Display final dataset info
sales_df.info()"}
